ValidationRule.description: Service Completion Date cannot be a date in the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP Department Add Only") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DMS") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: Upsell") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: New Customer Setup") )&& OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Service_Completion_Date__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Service_Completion_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Service_Completion_Date__c) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Service_Completion_Date__c)) || DATEVALUE(Service_Completion_Date__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Service_Completion_Date__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Service_Completion_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Service_Completion_Date__c) > TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Service Completion Date cannot be a date in the Future.
